title: The Golden Record In Space
description: The two Voyager Golden Records, one on each Voyager spacecraft launched in 1977, carry sounds and images meant to portray the diversity of life and culture on Earth. A committee chaired by Carl Sagan chose 116 images, natural sounds, greetings in 55 languages, and music from Bach to Chuck Berry. The records also carry an hour of Ann Druyan's brainwaves compressed into a minute of audio. Source: Wikipedia, Voyager Golden Record.
